fields.summary_ko.0: SK Hynix (NASDAQ:SKHY) rose 6–8% on October 27, moving from approximately KRW 1,357,000 to KRW 1,380,000 in Seoul closing, with U.S. ADR moving from $142.62 to $145.15.
fields.summary_ko.1: SK Hynix scheduled to report Q3 results on October 28, with reports of special dividend plan around KRW 16 trillion (approximately $12B) pending confirmation.
